headline: A 2003 executive order dealing with the rules for three special military pays: hazardous duty, aviation career, and submarine duty pay.
what_it_does: This executive order concerns the regulations that govern three kinds of extra pay for members of the uniformed services: hazardous duty incentive pay, aviation career incentive pay, and submarine duty incentive pay. No summary was provided, so the specific rule changes it makes are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Service members who do hazardous duty
who_it_affects.how: The rules for their hazardous duty incentive pay are covered by this order.
The rules for their aviation career incentive pay are covered by this order.
The rules for their submarine duty incentive pay are covered by this order.
